title: The False Prophet of Revelation
lead: Revelation's name for the beast from the earth, which has horns like a lamb and talks like a dragon, and makes the world worship the first beast (Revelation 13:11–17; Revelation 16:13; Revelation 19:20). Jesus warned that false prophets would come with signs and wonders (Matthew 7:15; Matthew 24:24); for false prophets in general, see "False Teachers and False Prophets."
